context.claim: The server failed because the host did not pass the API key.
context.observations: Every inference tool returned missing_key, while the key is exported in ~/.bashrc.

data.text: GUI-launched desktop apps do not source ~/.bashrc, so variables exported there never reach an MCP server the app starts.
The .env sets JEV_PROVIDER=typesafe, so the server looks for TYPESAFE_API_KEY, while ~/.bashrc exports OPENROUTER_API_KEY.
The variable in ~/.bashrc is spelled OPENROUTER_APIKEY, without the underscore the server expects.
The account ran out of credit, so the provider rejected every request.
The project's README was last updated in September.
